name: Infernal Cinder-Chain Bailiff
loreTies: A contract enforcer of the Infernal Dominion; it fights for debt, jurisdiction, and ambition, not cartoon evil.
Drags the Titan into bad positions and taxes movement.
source culture humans later copied as hell, demonology, and infernal contract lore
shortBackstory: Infernal Cinder-Chain Bailiff is a lore-faithful Infernal Dominion run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Infernal Cinder-Chain Bailiff belongs to The Infernal Dominion and exists to express Infernal Dominion law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Drags the Titan into bad positions and taxes movement.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Black iron coat, ember chain ledgers, horned court mask, ash-red sigil cuffs. Abilities — Chain Writ, Debt Drag, Cinder Lock — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Titan-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
